name: Master Ball
gameText: The best Ball with the ultimate level of performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

name: Ultra Ball
gameText: An ultra-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.

name: Great Ball
gameText: A good, high-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.

name: Poké Ball
gameText: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It is thrown like a ball at the target. It is designed as a capsule system.

name: Safari Ball
gameText: A special Poké Ball that is used only in the Great Marsh. It is decorated in a camouflage pattern.

name: Net Ball
gameText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.

name: Dive Ball
gameText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Pokémon that live in the sea.

name: Nest Ball
gameText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on weaker Pokémon in the wild.

name: Repeat Ball
gameText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Pokémon species that were previously caught.

name: Timer Ball
gameText: A somewhat different Ball that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.

name: Luxury Ball
gameText: A comfortable Poké Ball that makes a caught wild Pokémon quickly grow friendly.

name: Premier Ball
gameText: A somewhat rare Poké Ball that has been specially made to commemorate an event of some sort.

name: Dusk Ball
gameText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark places like caves.

name: Heal Ball
gameText: A remedial Poké Ball that restores the caught Pokémon's HP and eliminates any status problem.

name: Quick Ball
gameText: A somewhat different Poké Ball that provides a better catch rate if it is used at the start of a wild encounter.

name: Cherish Ball
gameText: A quite rare Poké Ball that has been specially crafted to commemorate an occasion of some sort.

name: Potion
gameText: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

name: Antidote
gameText: A spray-type medicine. It lifts the effect of poison from one Pokémon.

name: Burn Heal
gameText: A spray-type medicine. It heals a single Pokémon that is suffering from a burn.

name: Ice Heal
gameText: A spray-type medicine. It defrosts a Pokémon that has been frozen solid.

name: Awakening
gameText: A spray-type medicine. It awakens a Pokémon from the clutches of sleep.

name: Parlyz Heal
gameText: A spray-type medicine. It eliminates paralysis from a single Pokémon.

name: Full Restore
gameText: A medicine that fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of a single Pokémon.

name: Max Potion
gameText: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It completely restores the HP of a single Pokémon.

name: Hyper Potion
gameText: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.

name: Super Potion
gameText: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

name: Full Heal
gameText: A spray-type medicine. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

name: Revive
gameText: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It restores half the Pokémon's maximum HP.

name: Max Revive
gameText: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It fully restores the Pokémon's HP.

name: Fresh Water
gameText: Water with a high mineral content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

name: Soda Pop
gameText: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.

name: Lemonade
gameText: A very sweet drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 80 points.

name: Moomoo Milk
gameText: Milk with a very high nutrition content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 100 points.

name: EnergyPowder
gameText: A very bitter medicine powder. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

name: Energy Root
gameText: A very bitter root. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.

name: Heal Powder
gameText: A very bitter medicine powder. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

name: Revival Herb
gameText: A very bitter medicinal herb. It revives a fainted Pokémon, fully restoring its HP.

name: Ether
gameText: It restores the PP of a Pokémon's selected move by a maximum of 10 points.

name: Max Ether
gameText: It fully restores the PP of a single selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.

name: Elixir
gameText: It restores the PP of all the moves learned by the targeted Pokémon by 10 points each.

name: Max Elixir
gameText: It fully restores the PP of all the moves learned by the targeted Pokémon.

name: Lava Cookie
gameText: Lavaridge Town's local specialty. It heals all the status problems of one Pokémon.

name: Berry Juice
gameText: A 100{01D2} pure juice made of Berries. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

name: Sacred Ash
gameText: It revives all fainted Pokémon. In doing so, it also fully restores their HP.

name: HP Up
gameText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base HP of a single Pokémon.

name: Protein
gameText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Attack stat of a single Pokémon.

name: Iron
gameText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Defense stat of a single Pokémon.

name: Carbos
gameText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Speed stat of a single Pokémon.

name: Calcium
gameText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Sp. Atk [Special Attack] stat of a single Pokémon.

name: Rare Candy
gameText: A candy that is packed with energy. It raises the level of a single Pokémon by one.

name: PP Up
gameText: It slightly raises the maximum PP of a selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.

name: Zinc
gameText: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Sp. Def [Special Defense] stat of a single Pokémon.

name: PP Max
gameText: It maximally raises the top PP of a selected move that has been learned by the target Pokémon.

name: Old Gateau
gameText: Old Chateau's hidden specialty. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

name: Guard Spec.
gameText: An item that prevents stat reduction among the Trainer's party Pokémon for five turns after use.

name: Dire Hit
gameText: An item that raises the critical-hit ratio of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Attack
gameText: An item that raises the Attack stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Defend
gameText: An item that raises the Defense stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Speed
gameText: An item that raises the Speed stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Accuracy
gameText: An item that raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Special
gameText: An item that raises the Sp. Atk stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Sp. Def
gameText: An item that raises the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: Poké Doll
gameText: A doll that attracts Pokémon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.

name: Fluffy Tail
gameText: An item that attracts Pokémon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.

name: Blue Flute
gameText: A blue flute made from blown glass. Its melody awakens a single Pokémon from sleep.

name: Yellow Flute
gameText: A yellow flute made from blown glass. Its melody snaps a single Pokémon out of confusion.

name: Red Flute
gameText: A red flute made from blown glass. Its melody snaps a single Pokémon out of infatuation.

name: Black Flute
gameText: A black flute made from blown glass. Its melody makes wild Pokémon less likely to appear.

name: White Flute
gameText: A white flute made from blown glass. Its melody makes wild Pokémon more likely to appear.

name: Shoal Salt
gameText: Pure salt that was discovered deep inside the Shoal Cave. It is extremely salty.

name: Shoal Shell
gameText: A pretty seashell that was found deep inside the Shoal Cave. It is striped in blue and white.

name: Red Shard
gameText: A small red shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.

name: Blue Shard
gameText: A small blue shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.

name: Yellow Shard
gameText: A small yellow shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.

name: Green Shard
gameText: A small green shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.

name: Super Repel
gameText: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 200 steps after its use.

name: Max Repel
gameText: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 250 steps after its use.

name: Escape Rope
gameText: A long, durable rope. Use it to escape instantly from a cave or a dungeon.

name: Repel
gameText: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 100 steps after its use.

name: Sun Stone
gameText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as red as the sun.

name: Moon Stone
gameText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as black as the night sky.

name: Fire Stone
gameText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is colored orange.

name: Thunderstone
gameText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a thunderbolt pattern.

name: Water Stone
gameText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a clear, light blue.

name: Leaf Stone
gameText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a leaf pattern.

name: TinyMushroom
gameText: A small and rare mushroom. It is quite popular among certain maniacal fan segments.

name: Big Mushroom
gameText: A large and rare mushroom. It is very popular among certain maniacal fan segments.

name: Pearl
gameText: A somewhat-small pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold cheaply to shops.

name: Big Pearl
gameText: A quite-large pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

name: Stardust
gameText: Lovely, red-colored sand with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

name: Star Piece
gameText: A shard of a pretty gem that sparkles in a red color. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

name: Nugget
gameText: A nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

name: Heart Scale
gameText: A pretty, heart-shaped scale that is extremely rare. It glows faintly in the colors of the rainbow.

name: Honey
gameText: A sweet honey with a lush aroma that attracts wild Pokémon when it is used in grass, caves, or on special trees.

name: Growth Mulch
gameText: A fertilizer to be spread on soft soil. It speeds up the growth of Berries. However, it also dries the soil faster.

name: Damp Mulch
gameText: A fertilizer to be spread on soft soil. It slows the growth of Berries and causes the soil to dry slower.

name: Stable Mulch
gameText: A fertilizer to be spread on soft soil. It extends the time ripened Berries remain on their plants before falling.

name: Gooey Mulch
gameText: A fertilizer to be spread on soft soil. It ups the number of times new plants grow where mature plants withered.

name: Root Fossil
gameText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It appears to be part of a plant root.

name: Claw Fossil
gameText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It appears to be part of a claw.

name: Helix Fossil
gameText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It appears to be part of a seashell.

name: Dome Fossil
gameText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea. It appears to be part of a shell.

name: Old Amber
gameText: A piece of amber that contains the genetic material of an ancient Pokémon. It is clear with a reddish tint.

name: Armor Fossil
gameText: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that lived on the land. It appears to be part of a collar.

name: Skull Fossil
gameText: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that lived on the land. It appears to be part of a head.

name: Rare Bone
gameText: A bone that is extremely valuable for Pokémon archaeology. It can be sold for a high price to shops.

name: Shiny Stone
gameText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It shines with a dazzling light.

name: Dusk Stone
gameText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as dark as dark can be.

name: Dawn Stone
gameText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It sparkles like eyes.

name: Oval Stone
gameText: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is shaped like an egg.

name: Odd Keystone

name: Griseous Orb
gameText: A glowing orb to be held by GIRATINA. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Ghost-type moves.

name: Adamant Orb
gameText: A brightly gleaming orb to be held by DIALGA. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Steel-type moves.

name: Lustrous Orb
gameText: A beautifully glowing orb to be held by PALKIA. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Water-type moves.

name: BrightPowder
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It casts a tricky glare that lowers the opponent's accuracy.

name: White Herb
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It restores any lowered stat in battle. It can be used only once.

name: Macho Brace

name: Exp. Share

name: Quick Claw

name: Soothe Bell

name: Mental Herb

name: Choice Band
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This headband ups Attack, but allows the use of only one kind of move.

name: King's Rock

name: SilverPowder

name: Amulet Coin

name: Cleanse Tag

name: Soul Dew

name: DeepSeaTooth

name: Smoke Ball

gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the “Tough” aspect of the holder in a Contest in Sinnoh.

name: Wide Lens
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of moves.

name: Muscle Band
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a headband that slightly boosts the power of physical moves.

name: Wise Glasses
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a thick pair of glasses that slightly boosts the power of special moves.

name: Expert Belt
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a well-worn belt that slightly boosts the power of supereffective moves.

name: Light Clay
gameText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of barrier moves like Light Screen and Reflect used by the holder.

name: Life Orb
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves, but at the cost of some HP on each hit.

name: Power Herb
gameText: A single-use item to be held by a Pokémon. It allows the immediate use of a move that charges on the first turn.

name: Toxic Orb
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that badly poisons the holder in battle.

name: Flame Orb
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that inflicts a burn on the holder in battle.

name: Quick Powder
gameText: An item to be held by DITTO. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Speed stat.

name: Focus Sash
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If it has full HP, the holder will endure one potential KO attack, leaving 1 HP.

name: Zoom Lens
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder moves after the foe, its accuracy will be boosted.

name: Metronome
gameText: A Pokémon held item that boosts a move used consecutively. Its effect is reset if another move is used.

name: Iron Ball
gameText: A Pokémon held item that cuts Speed. It makes Flying-type and levitating holders susceptible to Ground moves.

name: Lagging Tail
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is tremendously heavy and makes the holder move slower than usual.

name: Destiny Knot
gameText: A long, thin, bright red string to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder becomes infatuated, the foe does too.

name: Black Sludge
gameText: A held item that gradually restores the HP of Poison-type Pokémon. It inflicts damage on all other types.

name: Icy Rock
gameText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Hail used by the holder.

name: Smooth Rock
gameText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Sandstorm used by the holder.

name: Heat Rock
gameText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Sunny Day used by the holder.

name: Damp Rock
gameText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of the move Rain Dance used by the holder.

name: Grip Claw
gameText: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of multiturn attacks like Bind and Wrap.

name: Choice Scarf
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This scarf boosts Speed, but allows the use of only one kind of move.

name: Sticky Barb
gameText: A held item that damages the holder on every turn. It may latch on to foes that touch the holder.

name: Power Bracer
gameText: A Pokémon held item that promotes Attack gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

name: Power Belt
gameText: A Pokémon held item that promotes Defense gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

name: Power Lens
gameText: A Pokémon held item that promotes Sp. Atk gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

name: Power Band
gameText: A Pokémon held item that promotes Sp. Def gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

name: Power Anklet
gameText: A Pokémon held item that promotes Speed gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

name: Power Weight
gameText: A Pokémon held item that promotes HP gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.

name: Shed Shell
gameText: A tough, discarded carapace to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to switch with a waiting Pokémon in battle.

name: Big Root
gameText: A Pokémon held item that boosts the power of HP-stealing moves to let the holder recover more HP.

name: Choice Specs
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These distinctive glasses boost Sp. Atk, but allow only one kind of move to be used.

name: Flame Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.

name: Splash Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

name: Zap Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.

name: Meadow Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

name: Icicle Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ice-type moves.

name: Fist Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fighting-type moves.

name: Toxic Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.

name: Earth Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

name: Sky Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.

name: Mind Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

name: Insect Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Bug-type moves.

name: Stone Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

name: Spooky Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.

name: Draco Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dragon-type moves.

name: Dread Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dark-type moves.

name: Iron Plate
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Steel-type moves.

name: Odd Incense
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

name: Rock Incense
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

name: Full Incense
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that makes the holder bloated and slow moving.

name: Wave Incense
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

name: Rose Incense
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.

name: Luck Incense
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles a battle's prize money if the holding Pokémon joins in.

name: Pure Incense
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the first one in the party.

name: Protector
gameText: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: Electirizer
gameText: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: Magmarizer
gameText: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: Dubious Disc
gameText: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.

name: Reaper Cloth
gameText: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: Razor Claw
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sharply hooked claw that ups the holder's critical-hit ratio.

name: Razor Fang
gameText: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the foe to flinch when the holder inflicts damage.

name: TM01
gameText: The user focuses its mind before launching this attack. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

name: TM02
gameText: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.

name: TM03
gameText: The foe is hit with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.

name: TM04
gameText: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

name: TM05
gameText: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

name: TM06
gameText: A move that leaves the foe badly poisoned. This poison damage worsens every turn.

name: TM07
gameText: Summons a hailstorm that lasts for five turns. The hailstorm damages all types except Ice.

name: TM08
gameText: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

name: TM09
gameText: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

name: TM10
gameText: A variable move that changes type and power depending on the hidden ability of the Pokémon using it.

name: TM11
gameText: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

name: TM12
gameText: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.

name: TM13
gameText: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

name: TM14
gameText: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

name: TM15
gameText: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

name: TM16
gameText: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

name: TM17
gameText: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

name: TM18
gameText: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

name: TM19
gameText: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: TM20
gameText: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems like poison, paralysis, burn, and sleep.

name: TM21
gameText: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

name: TM22
gameText: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

name: TM23
gameText: The foe is slammed with a sturdy tail of steel. It may also lower the target's Defense stat if it hits.

name: TM24
gameText: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

name: TM25
gameText: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

name: TM26
gameText: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

name: TM27
gameText: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

name: TM28
gameText: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

name: TM29
gameText: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe's Sp. Def stat.

name: TM30
gameText: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe's Sp. Def stat.

name: TM31
gameText: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

name: TM32
gameText: The user begins moving so quickly that it creates illusory copies to raise its evasiveness.

name: TM33
gameText: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

name: TM34
gameText: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

name: TM35
gameText: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

name: TM36
gameText: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the foe. It may also poison the target.

name: TM37
gameText: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

name: TM38
gameText: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TM39
gameText: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It lowers the foe's Speed.

name: TM40
gameText: The user confounds the foe with speed, then strikes. The attack lands without fail.

name: TM41
gameText: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

name: TM42
gameText: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

name: TM43
gameText: An attack move with effects that vary depending on the user's environment.

name: TM44
gameText: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user's HP and heals any status problem.

name: TM45
gameText: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

name: TM46
gameText: The user attacks and steals the foe's held item simultaneously. It can't steal if the user holds an item.

name: TM47
gameText: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

name: TM48
gameText: The user employs its psychic power to exchange abilities with the foe.

name: TM49
gameText: The user steals the effects of any healing or status-changing move the foe attempts to use.

name: TM50
gameText: The user attacks the foe at full power using fiery energy. It also sharply reduces the user's Sp. Atk.

name: TM51
gameText: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user's HP by up to half of its max HP.

name: TM52
gameText: The user attacks at full power. It may also lower the foe's Sp. Def stat if it hits.

name: TM53
gameText: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

name: TM54
gameText: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

name: TM55
gameText: If the foe's HP is down to under half, this attack will hit with double the power.

name: TM56
gameText: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

name: TM57
gameText: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM58
gameText: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

name: TM59
gameText: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

name: TM60
gameText: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: TM61
gameText: The user shoots a sinister, bluish white flame at the foe to inflict a burn.

name: TM62
gameText: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user's stats.

name: TM63
gameText: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

name: TM64
gameText: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

name: TM65
gameText: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: TM66
gameText: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user can use this attack after the foe, its power is doubled.

name: TM67
gameText: The user recycles a single-use item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

name: TM68
gameText: The user charges the foe using every bit of its power. It must rest on the next turn to recover.

name: TM69
gameText: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It sharply raises the Speed stat.

name: TM70
gameText: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe's accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

name: TM71
gameText: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

name: TM72
gameText: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

name: TM73
gameText: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

name: TM74
gameText: The user tackles the foe from a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

name: TM75
gameText: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

name: TM76
gameText: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

name: TM77
gameText: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

name: TM78
gameText: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

name: TM79
gameText: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM80
gameText: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

name: TM81
gameText: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

name: TM82
gameText: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

name: TM83
gameText: The user draws power from the Berry it is holding to attack. The Berry determines its type and power.

name: TM84
gameText: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped with poison. It may also poison the foe.

name: TM85
gameText: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user's HP.

name: TM86
gameText: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

name: TM87
gameText: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe's Attack stat.

name: TM88
gameText: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

name: TM89
gameText: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

name: TM90
gameText: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.

name: TM91
gameText: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it in one shot. It may also lower the foe's Sp. Def stat.

name: TM92
gameText: The user creates a bizarre space in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

name: HM01
gameText: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

name: HM02
gameText: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used to fly to any familiar town.

name: HM03
gameText: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used to cross water.

name: HM04
gameText: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

name: HM05
gameText: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool. It can also be used to traverse whirlpools.

name: HM06
gameText: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

name: HM07
gameText: The user charges the foe at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

name: HM08
gameText: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

name: Mining Kit
gameText: A kit containing the basic tools for exploring the Mines of Groment City.

name: Loot Sack
gameText: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry loot obtained in the coal mine.

name: Rule Book
gameText: It lists the rules for holding battles. For linked battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.

name: Poké Radar
gameText: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

name: Point Card
gameText: A card that lists the Battle Points you have earned.

name: Journal
gameText: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.

name: Seal Case
gameText: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the Capsule cases of Poké Balls.

name: Fashion Case
gameText: A fancy case for the tidy arrangement and storage of whimsical Pokémon Accessories.

name: Seal Bag
gameText: A tiny bag that can hold ten Seals for decorating Poké Balls.

name: Pal Pad
gameText: A convenient notepad that is used for registering your friends, Friend Codes, and keeping a record of game play.

name: Works Key
gameText: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

name: Old Charm
gameText: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.

name: Galactic Key
gameText: A card key for disengaging security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.

name: Red Chain
gameText: A mythical chain that is said to link the legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.

name: Town Map
gameText: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

name: Vs. Seeker
gameText: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

name: Coin Case
gameText: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 50,000 coins.

name: Old Rod
gameText: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

name: Good Rod
gameText: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

name: Super Rod
gameText: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

name: Sprayduck
gameText: A watering can shaped like a PSYDUCK. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.

name: Poffin Case
gameText: A case for storing Poffin cooked from Berries.

name: Bicycle
gameText: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.

name: Suite Key
gameText: A key to one of the suites at the luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

name: Oak's Letter
gameText: A letter from Prof. Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Rt. 224.

name: Lunar Wing
gameText: A feather that glows like the moon. It is said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.

name: Member Card
gameText: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.

name: Azure Flute
gameText: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. It is unknown who made it.

name: S.S. Ticket
gameText: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

name: Contest Pass
gameText: The pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.

name: Magma Stone
gameText: A stone formed when boulders melted in intensely hot magma, then hardened. Magma remains sealed inside.

name: Parcel
gameText: A parcel the Professor entrusted you to take to Central City. It contains very important information.

name: Coupon 1
gameText: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch [Pokétch for short]. Three coupons are needed.

name: Coupon 2
gameText: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch [Pokétch for short]. Three coupons are needed.

name: Coupon 3
gameText: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch [Pokétch for short]. Three coupons are needed.

name: Storage Key
gameText: The key to Team Galactic's sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

name: SecretPotion
gameText: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.

name: Vs. Recorder
gameText: An amazing device that can record a battle either between friends or at a special battle facility.

name: Gracidea
gameText: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.

name: Secret Key
gameText: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electric signal to open a door.

name: Apricorn Box
gameText: A handy box where you can store up to 99 Apricorns of each kind.

name: UNOWN Report
gameText: A report of all the discovered kinds of UNOWN.

name: Berry Pots
gameText: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.

name: Dowsing MCHN
gameText: It checks for unseen items in the area and makes noise and lights when it finds something.

name: Blue Card
gameText: A card to save points for the Buena's Password show.

name: SlowpokeTail
gameText: A very tasty tail of something. It sells for a high price.

name: Clear Bell
gameText: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing.

name: Card Key
gameText: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.

name: Dungeon Key
gameText: A very old key that opens the door to some hidden place. It has a bit of rust.

name: SquirtBottle
gameText: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.

name: Red Scale
gameText: A scale from the red GYARADOS. It glows red like a flame.

name: Lost Item
gameText: The Poké Doll lost by the Copycat.

name: Pass
gameText: A ticket required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows you to ride whenever and however much you'd like.

name: Machine Part
gameText: An important machine part for the Power Plant that was stolen.

name: Silver Wing
gameText: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.

name: Rainbow Wing
gameText: A mystical, rainbow feather that sparkles.

name: Mystery Egg
gameText: A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokémon. What's in the Egg is unknown.

name: Red Apricorn
gameText: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.

name: Ylw Apricorn
gameText: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.

name: Blu Apricorn
gameText: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.

name: Grn Apricorn
gameText: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.

name: Pnk Apricorn
gameText: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.

name: Wht Apricorn
gameText: A white Apricorn. It doesn't smell like anything.

name: Blk Apricorn
gameText: A black Apricorn It has an indescribable scent.

name: Fast Ball
gameText: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch fast Pokémon.

name: Level Ball
gameText: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that are a lower level than your own.

name: Lure Ball
gameText: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon hooked by a Rod when fishing.

name: Heavy Ball
gameText: A Poké Ball for catching very heavy Pokémon.

name: Love Ball
gameText: Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that are the opposite gender of your Pokémon.

name: Friend Ball
gameText: A Poké Ball that makes caught Pokémon more friendly.

name: Moon Ball
gameText: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that evolve using the Moon Stone.

name: Sport Ball
gameText: A special Poké Ball for the Bug-Catching Contest.

name: Park Ball
gameText: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.

name: Photo Album
gameText: A nice photo album for storing all the photos taken along your adventure.

name: GB Sounds
gameText: A music player that allows you to listen to nostalgic songs. It's operated with a single switch.

name: Tidal Bell
gameText: An old-fashioned bell with a gentle, soothing sound.

name: RageCandyBar
gameText: A famous candy in Mahogany Town. Many tourists like to buy them to take home.

name: Data Card 01
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many victories you've had.

name: Data Card 02
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many losses you've had.

name: Data Card 03
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have dashed.

name: Data Card 04
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have jumped.

name: Data Card 05
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won the Hurdle Dash.

name: Data Card 06
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won the Relay Run.

name: Data Card 07
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Pennant Capture.

name: Data Card 08
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Block Smash.

name: Data Card 09
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Disc Catch.

name: Data Card 10
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Snow Throw.

name: Data Card 11
gameText: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many points your Pokémon scored.

name: Data Card 12
